name: Jobs 253 Summer Credential Programs
what_you_do: Free summer training from experts. The 2026 page lists courses in cars, cooking, digital drawing, business starts, plumbing, building, drones and wildland fire. Students earn credentials.
who_can_apply: Tacoma Public Schools high school students and students of partner Maritime|253 districts. For the drone course you must be 16 or older to earn the FAA Part 107 certificate. The ANEW program is for ages 16 to 18 with a disability. See its own card.
duration: Varies by course (the auto course ran June 22 to July 9, Monday to Thursday, 8 am to 3 pm)
deadline_text: The auto course priority deadline was April 30. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Tacoma Public Schools Jobs 253 pages when courses are posted. Contact the course lead listed on the page.
notes: Open to TPS and partner district students only. Each course has its own dates, spots and lead; the auto course ran June 22 to July 9 in 2026. Work permit rule not stated.
